serial.workspace_semantics: resident orchestration buffer, not a claim of shared GPU4PySCF operator assets
limitations: The async mode overlaps independent molecule chains with non-blocking CuPy streams but keeps each molecule's response assets ordered.

process_isolated.scientific_backend: official GPU4PySCF; no fused or altered kernels
limitations: Each worker owns a separate CUDA context on one physical GPU. This is not a same-context stream runtime.
Process startup, context creation and duplicated resident state are included in elapsed_seconds.
No cross-molecule operator-value reuse or fused ragged kernel is claimed.
This compares process-isolated receipts to a serial receipt. It does not establish a same-context stream speedup.
Process startup and duplicated CUDA contexts are included in the process elapsed time.
